# Code of Conduct

Alright I'm gonna keep this simple. You are allowed to use and contribute to this repository at my personal discretion, but I will generally be alright with you as long as you keep the following in mind:

## 1. NO BIGOTRY

This includes but is not limited to:

- LGBTQ-phobic behavior
- Slurs of any kind ("cis" is not a slur btw)
- White supremacist names, slogans, and beliefs
- Any MAGA bullshit
- Anything denying the humanity of any oppressed peoples around the world or people who have historically experienced oppression

This repository is also explicitly 🏳️‍⚧️ TRANS RIGHTS FRIENDLY 🏳️‍⚧️ and believes that the Magic community is better when we're supportive of each others' life choices.

## 2. TAKE ARGUMENTS OFFLINE

No fighting in my issues, PRs, discussion boards, and so on.
There is a time and a place for discussions that get a little heated.
Now is not one of those times and here is not one of those places.
Take your drama elsewhere.

## 3. NO SLOP

AI use is okay.
In many ways it's the new normal for programming so I can't be upset at that on its own.
However, if you are sending me thousands of lines of PRs with bad structure or not following established repository conventions, you could be banned from contributing.
Let me make myself clear: AI is okay, but thoughtless slop is not.

If you're using AI to contribute to my repository, please review it yourself (or pass it through a couple reviews on your own end first by an agent CLI or something) before asking me to take a look.
It seriously wastes my time to be disregarding basic etiquette in this way.

---

If you follow these general guidelines, we can have a healthy and happy working relationship.
Magic as a game and a community is built on trust and respect so I expect that here, and you'll receive it in return.

-- Ryan Peters, author of Ritual
